title: Burnt through Claude x20 Ultra within 24 Hours
author: dn4r
selftext:
I am developing a trading management system that learns, just like many others, I have the Claude x20 Ultra plan and burnt through it within 24hrs of testing LOL......

I didn't use Claude code.

It ran back ground tasks and multiple agents at once testing, developing, Self hacking and finding holes and bugs.

Designed my own back testing arena with strict rules.

Do you guys have any better ways to use Claude or manage it better with prompts or agents so you don't burn through usage so fast 🤣😂🫢

replies.author: dn4r
replies.body: You could, under another account, but it wouldn't have your chat history, I guess you can ask claude to make a mark down of everything, plus feed it the files

replies.author: fomoz
replies.body:
No, it's fine.

Ask it to create a script to sync the chat history. I've been doing this for two months, across 4 accounts. It takes 1 min to switch between accounts and sync chat history.

replies.author: dn4r
replies.body: No way???? That is frikken epic!

comments.author: Alphanet_dogwalker
comments.body: I'd check what each agent is getting back after a run. A short failure summary and one broken trade are usually more useful than the entire log. Also give each agent a specific job and a retry limit. Otherwise several agents can spend the day rediscovering the same bug.

comments.author: Due_Set_6523
comments.body: set max iterations and a stop condition. cap your agents so you don't lose a day’s usage overnight.

comments.author: Either-Nobody-3962
comments.body:
first thing is, do it as claude project.  
and ask it to write documents for whatever done so far and read them then update docs (or ask claude to do it) with the features you want to see.

then your usage goes down a lot.

advantage with projects feature is, claude runs many bash/cmd scripts on your pc instead of consuming tokens so you will burn less.

feel free to dm me, if you need more help.

comments.author: hintheman
comments.body: I use Claude Code with a Pro plan $20/mo. It couldn't last and I added api usage credit with auto pay. It bills up $20 each and each day with full 8+ hours on CC adds up to $600 in 7 days.  It used to be cheaper with less usage that $300 a month is enough.  I upgraded to Ultra plan. I put in $100 credit + $200 ultra plan. In half a day I have $108 credit balance. My work in [https://tickersrank.ai/options-scanner](https://tickersrank.ai/options-scanner) and [https://tastydaytraders.com/explore](https://tastydaytraders.com/explore)
